card.name: Start of immunosuppressant terms
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word immunosuppressant, immunosuppressive or immunosuppression, split right after 'immun'. It appears in transplant and lymphoma warnings.

modes.label: Immunosuppress- word start
modes.description: The 'immun' piece that begins immunosuppressant, immunosuppressive or immunosuppression in transplant drug text.

card.writes: It promotes immune-related word starts such as ' immun' and 'imm', so the model continues with the rest of the immunosuppress- word.
card.plain: It fires on the opening of the word immunosuppressant, just before the model completes it.
